mathematical_findings.slope_sign_rigidity: For original k,a,b positive and physical T>=0, mu(ka)mu(kb)*K_T(ka,kb)=mu(a)mu(b)*W(k,a,b,T), W>=0. Noncoprime multipliers vanish by exact original squareful-zero.
mathematical_findings.shifted_source: W is original mu(k)^2/k * K_(T-log k)(a,b) only under coprime(k,a),coprime(k,b); true original source masks remain at ga,gb and T.
mathematical_findings.no_intra_slope_cancellation: For arbitrary positive integer multiplier inventory and full original pair masks, the absolute value of the signed slope packet equals the sum of absolute original masked terms.
mathematical_findings.prime_free_core: The unchanged original otherLowGcdCross Q T equals the sum over coprime primitive slopes (a,b) of mu(a)mu(b) times their nonnegative original g-dilation mass.
mathematical_findings.new_nonpositive_sector: Every opposite-sign primitive slope packet in the original prime-free low-gcd core is nonpositive, including incomparable slopes, disjoint from excluded prime dilations.
mathematical_findings.exact_quartic_sign: For any four original nonnegative integer indices m,n,r,s with ms=nr, mu(m)mu(n)mu(r)mu(s)>=0; squarefree case follows from the completely multiplicative Liouville function.
mathematical_findings.noalias: When q>=floor(exp T)^2, each surviving ORIGINAL modular ratio-collision four-index term is nonnegative individually, provided T>=0 and original denominator-unit masks are honored.
mathematical_findings.quartic_diagonal_floor: The all-character real original cross second moment >= phi(q)*originalRatioDiagonalEnergy(q,T), where the diagonal is equality of ordered pair labels p=t, NOT the original pickup m=n diagonal.
mathematical_findings.fixed_modulus_counterexample: q=7, (m,n)=(2,3), (r,s)=(1,5): equal modular unit ratios=3, unequal integer rational slopes, opposite nonzero fourfold mu signs. Thus termwise positivity is false without noalias.
mathematical_findings.RH: NOT_CLAIMED; required signed cancellation BETWEEN distinct primitive slopes remains OPEN.
